pr_body:
- Allow for automatically making loops that end conditional branches be atomic
- Allow for using a following expression conditional to make a prior loop atomic
- Allow conditionals to influence the computed minimum length

Fixes https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/62723
Contributes to https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/62449

issue_context.title: RegexNode.ComputeMinLength should do better for some Testref/Testgroup nodes
issue_context.body: Today these always report a min length of 0. That's correct if there's only a "yes" child branch.  But if there's also a "no" child branch, we should instead compute the minimum of both branches.

review_comments:
are there enough tests ensuring this doesn't happen if there's incompatible options? eg this should not atomify:
`(a(?-i:b)(?-i:B*)|def)ghi`
and possibly the same for other options. I don't see `(?-i` in this file at all.

With respect to options, perhaps these should have a optional global option. So
`[InlineData("abB*", "ab+", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase]` should pass?

> With respect to options, perhaps these should have a optional global option

The options check / impact will go away https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/61048; since we're ignoring RightToLeft, the only other option that's relevant here (and the reason this check exists) is IgnoreCase, and after #61048, IgnoreCase will be removed from everything except for backreferences.
Ah, yes.  Unrelated, it does seem we're a little short on functional tests of inline enable/disable of options, I'll make a note.

Those are just two branches, one of which is Empty.  I can add them if you think it's valuable, but I also would be very surprised if those failed and all of the other tests passed.  It'll exercise all the same paths as the tests that are there that test two branches, picking the min, and in this case the min is zero.
channeling my edge case tester DNA. sure, as you wish.
